topic: Adding frame type to data API endpoint
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adding the ability to retrieve frame types within the data API. Initially, it was noted that conceptually, frame type belongs to the frame itself, and the current data API only returns information based on screenshots (scans). However, it was determined that since a single screenshot might contain frames of different types, this feature is necessary.

**Decision:** The field for frame type will be added directly into the `/locations` endpoint. If multiple frame types are found for a given screen, they will be returned as a comma-separated list.
decisions: Add frame type information to the /locations data API endpoint
Return multiple frame types as a comma-separated string in the /locations endpoint
action_items: [me] will implement and update the /locations endpoint with the new field.
